transcript: We're Cara and Nate. Over the last 10 years, we've traveled to 112 countries documenting the entire journey here on our YouTube channel. Over the years, we've had the opportunity to spend time on a lot of really cool cruises, including a two-week cruise to Antarctica, a luxury icebreaker that took us all the way to the North Pole, cruising down the Nile, through the Galapagos, in the frozen fjords of Norway with orcas, most recently, a Christmas market cruise through Europe, and many, many more. This cruise on the Zambian Queen is going to be completely different from anything we've ever done. That was the moment I was hoping for on this trip. Because I'm pretty sure this section of the Chobe River that forms the border between Botswana and Namibia is the only place in the world where you can do a floating safari. So the idea of this cruise is that the boat acts like a floating safari lodge. We don't even have a scheduled trip from point A to point B. Instead we move up and down the river searching for the best wildlife encounters. Instead of pool decks and ports of call, our daily activities will happen on tiny boats and we're going out in search of some of Africa's most iconic wildlife. Did you just wave at us? I waved and you waved back. Best safari ever! So, join me, Nate and our friend Charlie for the next three days as we experience one of the world's only river cruise safaris.
